programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.desc: Origami is the traditional Japanese art of folding paper into decorative shapes and figures without cutting or glue.Learn how to make an amazing 3D origami fish with easy paper folding steps.

programme.title: Privada Cigar Club
programme.desc: In this episode, we're diving into our latest cigar curated exclusively for you. Join us as we reveal one of the first production release of our new bourbon barrel aged cigars.

programme.title: Interview
programme.desc: The dynamic world of soccer through exclusive interviews with key figures in the game. Uncover the untold stories behind the goals, strategies, and triumphs that shape the beautiful game.

programme.title: Silent Revolution
programme.desc: A documentary series exploring the European BMX scene, following riders across competitions, training, and daily life to reveal the dedication, culture, and challenges behind professional BMX.

programme.title: Shifting Gears
programme.desc: Shifting Gears is the all-new authoritative guide to the latest trends and technology from within today’s ever-changing automotive industry. From the racetrack to the suburban street, Shifting Gears delivers the most up-to-date news on cutting edge research, development and design. We delve beneath the skin of some of the most advanced machines on the planet – we visit international motor shows for the newest releases and concept vehicles; uncover new advances in technology developed both in the laboratory and on the race track; keep up to date in the race for alternative fuels, improved safety, satellite navigation, in-car entertainment and multi-media connectivity; and look ahead to the designs and trends of the future. From luxury dream machines and fantasy prototypes to the globally marketed mainstays, our access to the world’s leading race teams and automotive manufacturers ensure we have every corner covered. Enjoy the ride, as the future unfolds and we keep on shifting gears!

programme.title: Long Gone WIld
programme.desc: Long Gone Wild explores the plight of captive orcas, following Blackfish with a new perspective. The film covers: (1) the impact of Blackfish on SeaWorld; (2) the case against captivity; (3) orcas as sentient beings; (4) The Whale Sanctuary Project offering a safe haven; and (5) the threat posed by mega-aquariums in Russia and China. Through interviews with experts, compelling visuals, and a powerful soundtrack, it reveals the urgent need for orca protection.

programme.title: How To Make 3D Dog
programme.desc: Origami is the traditional Japanese art of folding paper into decorative shapes and figures without cutting or glue.Create a 3D origami dog using simple steps and clear paper folding instructions.

programme.title: Zenith
programme.desc: Researchers interested in Saturn's ring system utilise the Cassini probe, that has spent more than 13 years examining the Saturnian system.

programme.title: Clemente
programme.desc: Dan goes fishing for Calico Bass aboard the Clemente

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: Germany 1916. Misery, decay, ruins are everywhere. In this desolation two outsiders start a timid friendship which is abruptly changed when the war reaches the small village. The First World War is in full swing and Marga is fighting for survival. Her husband Otto disappeared in the war, she keeps herself alive by stealing potatoes and selling moonshine.

Elena is a student in Minsk making illegal deals in the Chernobyl death zone to save her father from going to prison. She is in an intense but increasingly destructive love affair with Viktor. When her father is arrested for illegal metal trading and tax evasion, in order to continue his business, she has to keep traveling to the Chernobyl restricted zone.

programme.title: One Ticket Please
programme.desc: An elderly woman is shaking up Manhattan's theater scene. The biographical documentary features an enthusiastic New York theatergoer, who manages to get tickets by any means necessary. Nicki Cochrane is an urban legend in the New York theater scene. The 78-year-old has seen at least one play a day for over a quarter of a century.

programme.title: Vidas Bienestar Con Estilo
programme.sub-title: Basquet Musica Superacion Sindrome de down
programme.desc: La serie presenta historias inspiradoras de personas que han hecho del bienestar una forma de vida. A traves de deportistas, aventureros y protagonistas del mundo saludable, cada episodio revela experiencias de superacion, conexion con la naturaleza y estilos de vida que promueven equilibrio, salud y armona.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

Mais également découvrir la culture des premiers habitants de l'île, les Mélanésiens.

programme.title: Eglise du Primat de Saint Pierre, Israel

programme.title: Amor Musical

Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

Il s’agit d’une eglise gothique construite par les Hospitaliers en 1140. En 1889, le gouvernement français acquiert ce magnifique monastere et le site passe sous la supervision des peres benedictins français.

programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Tesla Model 3 Highland: Weltklasse, aber patzt in manchen Sachen
programme.desc: Das Tesla Model 3 galt zeitweise als meistverkauftes Elektroauto in Deutschland und auf dem Kontinent. Was macht Tesla so besonders und was kann das neue Update? Alex Bloch bittet das frisch geliftete Tesla Model 3 Highland zum ersten Check.

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Spinnt Mazda?
programme.desc: Warum entwickelt ein Automobilhersteller wie Mazda weiterhin neue und große Dieselmotoren? Dabei ist der Markt für dieselbetriebene Fahrzeuge stark rückläufig und die Motoren haben in Bezug auf Effizienz scheinbar ihre Entwicklungsgrenze erreicht. Alexander Bloch erklärt, warum die Situation deutlich komplexer ist, als sie auf den ersten Blick erscheint.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Rivian R1T
programme.desc: Das US-Start-Up Rivian versucht, im ersten Aufschlag einen Pick-Up auf die Straße zu bringen, der alles kann. Denn sie behaupten, dass er fährt wie ein Sportwagen und geländegängig ist wie ein Off-Roader. Ähnlich wie beim Tesla Cybertruck, bietet der Rivian unglaubliche Fahrdaten. 835 PS, 1.231 Newtonmeter Drehmoment und von 0 auf 100 in 3 Sekunden.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - WLTP bei E-Autos
programme.desc: Mit dem WLTP-Verbrauch sollte alles besser werden: Endlich realistische Angaben zum Verbrauch eines Fahrzeugs und keine geschönten Mini-Verbräuche. Doch ist das wirklich so? WLTP ist vor allem für Verbrenner optimiert worden, für Elektro-Autos ist das Verfahren aus verschiedenen Gründen unbrauchbar. Die fünf größten WLTP-Fehler im Zusammenhang mit E-Autos hat Alex im Video.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - BMW M4 CSL
programme.desc: Ja, Alex findet die Optik des BMW M4 CSL tatsächlich Wow! Was ihn sonst noch am sportlichen Coupé begeistert, und was nicht so, erfahrt ihr im Video.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Honda Civic Type R
programme.desc: Messgerät rein und Abfahrt: Alex kann seine Begeisterung für die Handschaltung und den drehfreudigen Turbo-Motor des Honda Civic Type R nicht verbergen. Ist er "nur" emotional oder performt er auch gut? Kleiner Spoiler: Bei der Bremsmessung gibt's eine Riesen-Überraschung!

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - MG Marvel R
programme.desc: Mit dem MG Marvel R kommt das erste chinesische Elektro-Auto zum Supertest mit Alexander Bloch. Kann er den arrivierten Herstellern aus Südkorea, Amerika und Deutschland die Stirn bieten? Alex findet es heraus.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Genesis GV60
programme.desc: Genesis ist die Luxus-Tochter von Kia und Hyundai. Auf der gleichen Plattform wie KIA EV6 und Hyundai Ioniq5 kommt der Genesis mit 435 PS Leistung und soll in nur 4 Sekunden auf 100 km/h beschleunigen.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - BMW i4 40 iDrive
programme.desc: BMW stellt mit dem BMW i4 eDrive40 ein E-Auto auf einer Verbrennerplattform auf die Straße. Wie gut das funktionieren kann, testet Alexander Bloch. Denn die Konkurrenz Tesla Model 3 Long Range, der Genesis GV 60 oder der Hyundai Ioniq 5 haben im E-Auto-Supertest bereits ordentlich vorgelegt.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Audi Concept C: "Audi, ihr traut euch was!"
programme.desc: Audi war in den letzten Jahren beim Design eher weniger mutig. Auch bei der Qualität hinkten die Ingolstädter ihrem eigenen Anspruch hinterher. Mit dem Audi Concept C wagt die Marke einen radikalen Schritt: Eine neue Designsprache, die Anleihen an frühere Audi-Ikonen nimmt. Dazu hochwertige Materialien und eine spürbar bessere Qualität.

programme.title: Fast Lap
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Back to the future
programme.desc: Ohne sie wären diese Filme undenkbar. Der DeLorean DMC 12 aus Zurück in die Zukunft und der Ecto1 aus Ghostbusters. Wir zeigen euch alle wichtigen Details zu den Autos und ihre Besonderheiten.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Der Bobby Car Test
programme.desc: Das Bobby Car ist so erfolgreich wie VW Käfer, Toyota Corolla oder Ford Model T: Über 20 Millionen Exemplare fahren oder fuhren in Kinderzimmern auf der Welt. Alex Bloch testet heute die wichtigsten Bobby Cars auf Herz und Nieren.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Tesla Model S Plaid
programme.desc: Das Model S Plaid ist Teslas rollender Superlativ. Mit 1020 PS soll es nichts geringeres sein als das schnellste Serienauto der Welt, zumindest wenn es um die Beschleunigung von 0 auf 100 km/h geht. Aber stimmt das wirklich? Beschleunigt das Model S Plaid tatsächlich in 2,1 Sekunden auf Landstraßentempo. Diesem und 8 weiteren Mythen und Irrtümern rund um das Tesla Model S Plaid geht Alexander Bloch in dieser Folge Bloch erklärt auf den Grund.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Bugatti-Motor
programme.desc: Heute hat Alexander Bloch ein ganz besonderes Spielzeug: einen funktionsfähigen Nachbau des W16-Motors aus dem Bugatti Veyron. Gebaut von Turbo-Nerd und Saab-Motorenentwickler Per Gillbrandt. Alex zeigt euch die wichtigsten Details des exklusiven Miniatur-Nachbaus und klärt die wichtigste Frage: Wird er anspringen?

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Scaleart Unimog
programme.desc: Alex spielt heute mit dem Scaleart Unimog, ein echtes Manufaktur-Meisterwerk. Detailreicher und detailgetreuer geht es nicht. Wir zeigen alle Details und fahren den Unimog auch im Gelände.

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Porsche Taycan im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Porsche hat den Taycan umfangreich überarbeitet und in vielen Disziplinen verbessert. Die Batterie wird größer und kann schneller Laden. Alex Bloch fährt den Basis Taycan mit großer Batterie im E-Auto-Supertest und kommt aus dem Grinsen nicht mehr raus. Wie die Chancen stehen, dass der Taycan auf die Pole Position der Elektroautos fährt, seht ihr im Video.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der MG4 Electric im E-Auto Supertest
programme.desc: Der MG4 schwimmt auf der Erfolgswelle! Der Überflieger befindet sich unter den Top 5 der meistverkauften Elektroautos in Deutschland. Was der chinesischen Kompaktstromer im Vergleich zum Opel Astra Electric und dem VW ID.3 drauf hat, klärt Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS
programme.desc: Kein anderes Auto hat Alexander Bloch bisher in ein solches Wechselbad der Gefühle geschmissen. Von „sensationell!“ bis „macht ihr Witze?“ ist alles dabei. Was die Stärken und Schwächen des Opel Astra Electric sind und ob er sich gegen den VW ID.3 behaupten kann, erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Comeback des Wankelmotors - So fährt sich der Mazda MX-30 R-EV
programme.desc: Im Mazda MX-30 R-EV sorgt ein Wankelmotor für den Strom der E-Maschine - ein sogenannter Range Extender. Wie sich das ungewöhnliche Konzept fährt und was es für Vorteile hat, findet Alexander Bloch heraus.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Traxxas X Maxx
programme.desc: Der Traxxas Xmaxx ist ein wahres Monster unter den RC-Cars. Mit satten 6 PS und einer Spitzengeschwindigkeit von 80 km/h rollt der Traxxas über die Motocross-Strecke des MSC Kleinhau.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Porsche 911 T
programme.desc: Porsche 911 T mit Ölklappe sind nicht dafür bekannt besonders günstig zu sein. Doch dieses Modell kostet 1.000.000 €. Warum das so ist erklärt Alexander Bloch in dieser Folge Bloch erklärt.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 5 x Auto-Technik, die unlogisch erscheint
programme.desc: Höheres Gewicht bringt einen kürzeren Bremsweg, Elektromotoren beschleunigen und bremsen gleichzeitig und größere Verbrennungsmotoren, die effizienter sind als kleine: In der Auto-Technik gibt es einige Dinge, die auf den ersten Blick unlogisch wirken. Ob sie das wirklich sind, klärt Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Gran Turismo 7 mit VR-Brille: Sehr geil, aber der Magen rebelliert!
programme.desc: Gran Turismo funktioniert jetzt auch mit der Sony VR2-Brille! Da stürzt Alex sich gleich in die Renn-Action. Allerdings hat er die Rechnung ohne seinen Magen gemacht...

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: Quando una meteora si schianta sulla luna e ne sposta l'asse, la gravità terrestre trascina la luna sulla traiettoria del pianeta. Ora un gruppo di scienziati deve capire come impedire alla luna di colpire la Terra prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: 2012: Il Giorno Del Giudizio
programme.desc: 21 dicembre 2012. Quattro stranieri in viaggio si ritrovano ai piedi di un antico tempio inesplorato nel cuore del Messico. Per i Maya è l'ultimo giorno del calendario, per gli scienziati della Nasa è una catastrofica inversione dei poli magnetici della terra. Per l'umanità è il giorno del giudizio. L'apocalisse è vicina.

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: Ice Storm - Tempesta Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Disaster movie targato Asylum. Quando una violenta tempesta invernale colpisce la Carolina del Nord, trascinando le temperature al minimo storico, l'intero Stato rischia di precipitare in una glaciale catastrofe. Mentre il gelo avanza, scienziati ed esperti lottano contro il tempo per salvare vite umane e fermare il disastro prima che tutta la costa orientale venga inghiottita dal ghiaccio.

programme.title: 40 Days And Nights - Apocalisse Finale
programme.desc: Se un imponente spostamento tettonico causasse uno tsunami di proporzioni enormi, quale sarebbe l'unica soluzione? Recuperare l'insegnamento di Noè e della sua arca e costruire un'enorme nave capace di contenere solo cinquantamila persone, più il DNA di tutte le specie esistenti al mondo, cercando così di salvarle da una tempesta apocalittica.

programme.title: Alienate - Lotta Per La Terra
programme.desc: Ormai alla fine del suo matrimonio, David parte per un viaggio di lavoro per dare alla moglie un po' di spazio. Tuttavia, quando gli aerei cominciano a cadere misteriosamente dal cielo, si ritrova intrappolato in un'invasione aliena.

programme.title: Alien Convergence
programme.desc: Una squadra, composta da persone con disabilità fisiche, sviluppa un rivoluzionario progetto per pilotare gli aerei da combattimento attraverso un collegamento neurale. Quando dalla NASA scoprono che qualcosa sta per entrare nell'atmosfera, tale progetto viene messo in atto per respingere un'invasione aliena.

programme.title: 20.0 Megaquake
programme.desc: Mentre un mega-terremoto minaccia San Francisco, una serie di scosse di preavviso crea scompiglio in tutta la città. Una squadra d'élite di esperti di servizi di emergenza e di catastrofi converge sull'epicentro previsto, lavorando instancabilmente per salvare quante più vite possibili prima che la città venga schiacciata nell'oblio.

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application? Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: Global business voices on China-US trade relations
programme.desc: China-US relations draws global attention, the global business community is closely watching what US President Donald Trump's visit to China means for trade, investment and market confidence. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN’s Lincoln Humphries sits down with Fred Teng, president of the AmericaChina Public Affairs Institute, Chris Torrens, chairman of the British Chamber of Commerce in China, and Oliver Oehms, executive director and board member of the German Chamber of Commerce in China – North China; exploring investment sentiment, business trends and why China-US cooperation still matters in an uncertain global economy.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programme.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programme.title: Around China: Explore Lijiang's vibrant nighttime economy with Naxi culture
programme.desc: In recent years, Lijiang, Yunnan Province, has been leveraging its unique local resources to enrich and elevate its nighttime economy. By promoting activities such as nighttime dining, scenic views, and evening performances, Lijiang has unleashed vibrant consumer energy, attracting a growing number of tourists. Join CGTN Reporter Zhu Zhu to immerse in the Naxi ethnic wear, taking part in a bonfire party at Sifang Street, and explore Lijiang’s nighttime economy firsthand!

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: Welcome to Chongqing, China's largest city. Located in the country's southwest, it straddles two mighty rivers and is famed for its extraordinary skyline, with high-rises mushrooming out of the hills and vertigo-inducing bridges.But Tianran He and Angela Fu are here for the food: From xiaomian noodles and Jianghu cuisine to the city's most famous dish: Chongqing hotpot, our hosts take on the spicy, numbing and scintillating aromas of Chongqing cuisine. We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Rhythms of the Forest: A Sound of Li Instruments
programme.desc: Li bamboo and wood instruments offer a journey into the unique sounds of Hainan's Li ethnic group. Explore the ancient craftsmanship and musical heritage, from the resonant tones of bamboo flutes to the percussive rhythms of wooden drums. Experience the natural melodies that tell the stories of the Li people.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: Tales in Light and Shadow
programme.desc: Beijing shadow puppets bring ancient Chinese tales to life with intricately crafted leather figures. Behind an illuminated screen, these colorful silhouettes dance, enacting epic stories and folklore accompanied by traditional music. Discover this captivating performing art, a cherished part of China's rich cultural tapestry and a mesmerizing visual spectacle.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Rhythms of the Forest: A Sound of Li Instruments
programme.desc: Li bamboo and wood instruments offer a journey into the unique sounds of Hainan's Li ethnic group. Explore the ancient craftsmanship and musical heritage, from the resonant tones of bamboo flutes to the percussive rhythms of wooden drums. Experience the natural melodies that tell the stories of the Li people.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: Tales in Light and Shadow
programme.desc: Beijing shadow puppets bring ancient Chinese tales to life with intricately crafted leather figures. Behind an illuminated screen, these colorful silhouettes dance, enacting epic stories and folklore accompanied by traditional music. Discover this captivating performing art, a cherished part of China's rich cultural tapestry and a mesmerizing visual spectacle.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan

It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. programme.title: Diallelos
programme.desc: Dos estafadores locales se propusieron estafar a una ingenua empresaria japonesa y robar una gran suma de dinero.

programme.title: Fotos
programme.desc: Fotos cuenta la historia de Azucena, una joven de 22 años con aversión al sexo. Siempre lo ha considerado como algo prohibido y dañino, por lo que aún no ha mantenido relaciones con nadie, ni siquiera con su novio. Esta aversión provoca la ruptura con su pareja. Un día, Azucena conoce a César, un desequilibrado artista plástico que se obsesiona con ella. Ante el rechazo de la joven, el pintor intenta violarla. En su huída, Azucena conoce a Narciso, un travesti que acaba robando su corazón.

programme.title: Los Super
programme.desc: Tres personas de un barrio pobre se convierten en superheroes para librar a su barrio del crimen.

programme.title: Desbordar
programme.desc: Una muerte misteriosa reúne a dos amigos distanciados en un hospital psiquiátrico y los enfrenta a su historia.

En el año 2044, una mutacion de la plaga trajo la aniquilacion a tres cuartos de la humanidad. Los que quedan se han organizado en refugios distantes, y afuera, bandas de saqueadores controlan el territorio.

programme.title: De la misma sangre
programme.desc: Un policia trata de proteger a su hermano, quien trabaja para un poderoso narcotraficante.

programme.title: Que parezca un accidente
programme.desc: Una mujer esta planeando matar a su yerno despues de enterarse de que es infiel a su hija.

programme.title: Lleno de ruido y dolor
programme.desc: En la Patagonia de 1928, un joven inexperto se arrepiente de robar un banco junto con dos bandoleros cuando las cosas no resultan como esperaba.

programme.title: Memorias de lo que no fue
programme.desc: En el sórdido submundo de la vida nocturna de la Ciudad de México, Fernando y Miguel se conocen durante una noche salvaje en un famoso club gay. Lo que comienza como un encuentro casual se transforma en un misterio inquietante cuando Fernando despierta a la mañana siguiente sin recordar quién es ni cómo llegó allí. Sin ningún tipo de identificación y perdido en una niebla de confusión, se encuentra dependiendo de Miguel, quien promete ayudarle a descubrir su pasado olvidado. Mientras navegan por los fragmentos poco fiables de los recuerdos de Fernando, los dos jóvenes se ven arrojados a una relación intensa e inesperada. Su búsqueda de la verdad se vuelve cada vez más peligrosa, revelando oscuros secretos y peligros ocultos que acechan en las sombras de sus pasados. La historia avanza con la aparición de nuevos personajes envueltos en misterio e intriga, empujando a Fernando y Miguel al borde de su cordura. Lo que comienza como una exploración de la amnesia y la identidad se convierte en un thriller impactante, donde la búsqueda de respuestas se encuentra con el derramamiento de sangre y la venganza.

programme.title: De la misma sangre
programme.desc: Un policia trata de proteger a su hermano, quien trabaja para un poderoso narcotraficante.

programme.title: Que parezca un accidente
programme.desc: Una mujer esta planeando matar a su yerno despues de enterarse de que es infiel a su hija.

programme.title: 12 Catástrofes
programme.desc: El día que Jacey cumple 18 años empiezan a suceder cosas extrañas: el agua se vuelve roja, tornados aparecen de la nada y punzantes lanzas de hielo caen del cielo. Pronto se da cuenta que ella es la única que tiene el poder de detener la fatalidad inminente. Usando un antiguo libro de profecías mayas y con la ayuda de su padre, Jacey buscará la manera de frenar los doce desastres que han activado la cuenta atrás para el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Experimento Filadelfia
programme.desc: El intento por recrear un antiguo experimento secreto del gobierno fracasa y provoca un agujero espaciotemporal que hace que reaparezca el USS Eldridge, un acorazado de la Segunda Guerra Mundial que desapareció hace más de 70 años. Solo el único superviviente de la nave, acompañado por su nieta, una brillante científica, podrá detener la embarcación antes de que destroce el planeta.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: Cuando el mejor amigo del ex sheriff Alden Rockwell es tiroteado, éste se ofrece como investigador privado para averiguar la verdad tras el tiroteo y descubre una conspiración criminal entre dos condados.

programme.title: Santos y soldados
programme.desc: Cuatro soldados estadounidenses y un británico durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial luchan por regresar al territorio aliado después de ser separados de las fuerzas estadounidenses durante la histórica Masacre de Malmedy.

programme.title: Geo Disaster V2
programme.desc: Una familia de Los Ángeles se ve separada durante la convergencia de los mayores desastres de la historia: un supervolcán, un megaterremoto y un tornado masivo, e intentarán reunirse a toda costa.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: Un operativo de Black Ops es enviado a una remota estación de la CIA para proteger a un operador de código. Pronto se encuentran en una situación a vida o muerte, intentando desmantelar una trama letal antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Vacaciones Tragicas
programme.desc: Una familia se ve atrapada cuando la casa de vacaciones que alquilan se inunda por la lluvia y un agresivo tiburón ha conseguido entrar.

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

programme.title: Gun shy
programme.desc: La historia sigue a Turk Henry (Antonio Banderas), una superestrella del rock con discos de platino, casado con una supermodelo (Olga Kurylenko) y más rico de lo que jamás soñó. Durante unas vacaciones, su esposa es misteriosamente secuestrada por un grupo de piratas renegados sin barco. Con poca ayuda de las autoridades locales, Turk se ve obligado a embarcarse en una misión para rescatarla. Con habilidades más aptas para tocar el bajo, ligar y salir de fiesta, tendrá que enfrentarse a peligrosas selvas y a despiadados bandidos en esta divertida y trepidante aventura llena de acción.

programme.title: La Noche nunca Duerme
programme.desc: En el transcurso de una sola noche, el sargento de Crímenes Callejeros de Nueva York Thomas Cavanaugh (Dan Brennan) y sus compañeros Rourke (Stephanie Finochio) y Jablonsky (Robert Clohessy) persiguen a los asesinos de uno de los miembros de su grupo de trabajo, buscando información entre los sórdidos habitantes de un barrio infestado de delincuencia.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Una historia épica, que abarca décadas y continentes, sobre Ioannis Varvakis, un bribón de la época de la Ilustración que se puso del lado de los rusos en su guerra de 1768 contra los turcos, se hizo amigo de Catalina la Grande, amasó una fortuna con el caviar y luego lo donó todo para ayudar a su patria a luchar contra el imperio otomano.

programme.title: Truth or Die
programme.desc: Un millonario ha sido brutalmente asesinado en su casa y se han llevado un valioso maletín de la caja de seguridad. Cuando el guardaespaldas del millonario regresa a la escena del crimen, se encuentra con tres testigos-sospechosos: el hijo del millonario, una joven aparentemente dulce y un mago bohemio. Los tres relatan las escenas del asesinato desde puntos de vista opuestos, cada uno con una versión diferente de quién cometió el crimen.

programme.title: Sultanes
programme.desc: Una banda de ladrones roba en un banco mexicano y viaja a Argentina para blanquear el dinero. A su llegada, el plan se tuerce y les toca a ellos averiguar qué salió mal.

programme.title: Les Chroniques De Mars
programme.desc: John Carter, héros principal du Cycle de Mars de Edgard Rice Burroughs, se retrouve inexplicablement transporté sur la planète Mars 216, une planète imaginaire gravitant autour d'Alpha du Centaure, au beau milieu d'une guerre qui oppose deux races extra-terrestres...

programme.title: Face à la Tornade
programme.desc: Une entreprise américaine libère par inadvertance un vortex magnétique sur un monde non préparé.

programme.title: Karyn l'Obstinée
programme.desc: Une inspectrice de la criminelle est obligée de travailler avec son ex-fiancé pour enquêter sur un meurtre qui porte toutes les marques d'un infâme tueur en série.

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: La Colonie
programme.desc: Des groupes de personnes – des colonies – sont forcés de vivre sous terre à cause d'une nouvelle ère glaciaire. La Colonie 7 part vérifier la situation de la Colonie 5, avec laquelle ils ont perdu le contact. Sur place, ils découvrent que la colonie est tombée et qu’un tout nouvel ennemi les attend sur le chemin du retour.

programme.title: Hercules Reborn
programme.desc: La fiancée d'un jeune homme est kidnappée par un roi impitoyable, Hercule est appelé à l'aide. En exil depuis des années, le guerrier retrouve l'espoir à travers l'amour du garçon pour sa bien-aimée. Ensemble, ils vont combattre le tyran.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: Six ans après l'invasion de la Terre par les extraterrestres, un journaliste désabusé accepte d'escorter une touriste américaine choquée depuis une zone infectée au Mexique jusqu'à la sécurité de la frontière américaine.

programme.title: Narcopolis
programme.desc: Londres, 2024. Les drogues, devenues légales à la fabrication et à la consommation, sont contrôlées et exploitées par des sociétés pharmaceutiques. Mais un marché noir de substances bien plus dangereuses encore existe. Frank Grieves, agent de police faisant partie d’une unité d’élite chargée de lutter contre ce trafic, doit enquêter sur une affaire de corps non identifié. Il va devoir faire face à toute une organisation corrompue et ultra puissante.

programme.title: Bit
programme.desc: Une adolescente transgenre en vacances d'été à Los Angeles se bat pour survivre après être tombée sur quatre vampires féministes queer, qui tentent de débarrasser les rues de la ville des hommes prédateurs.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: Triple Action
programme.desc: Une mercenaire sexy et mortelle s'attaque à un syndicat international de trafiquants d'armes dirigé par la mafia russe.

programme.title: A Battle of Wits
programme.desc: L'histoire est centrée sur une bataille qui s'est déroulée pendant la période des États combattants en Chine, une série de guerres civiles qui s'est étendue du 5e au 3e siècle avant J.-C. Basée sur un manga japonais populaire, elle était elle-même basée sur un roman japonais inspiré de l'histoire des États combattants en Chine

programme.title: L'Apocalypse de Stonehenge
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un groupe d'archéologues déterre un squelette humain près du monument historique de STONEHENGE, une ancienne machine cachée sous la roche est découverte. Ne sachant pas de quoi il s'agit, les ouvriers déclenchent accidentellement le mécanisme et déclenchent une série d'événements qui pourraient bien mettre fin au monde tel que nous le connaissons.

programme.title: Piégés
programme.desc: Dans un flash-back, Ernesto, un jeune escroc, nous raconte comment il est arrivé au bord d'un gros coup : enfance dans un orphelinat, jeunes cambriolages à l'arraché jusqu'à ce que son partenaire se fasse prendre, puis encadrement par Lefty, un escroc vieillissant.

programme.title: La Vengeza de los cheyennes
programme.desc: Cuando Charlotte Sutter es secuestrada por los apaches, su hermano Sam, ayudado por un viejo prospector borracho, va en su busca.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Gladiatore
programme.desc: Diretto da Alfonso Brescia con Mark Forest, un gladiatore affronta tiranni e tradimenti in una Roma dominata dal potere.

programme.title: El angel vengador
programme.desc: Miles Utley es un comando/guardaespaldas mormón profesional que se ve obligado a convertirse en renegado y a cuestionar su fe cuando investiga un escándalo de asesinato y especulación de tierras.

programme.title: Robin, Frecce, Fagioli E Karate
programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP23 - Justicia del desierto
programme.desc: Como ocurre a menudo en Bonanza, las cosas no son siempre lo que parecen a primera vista. Hoss y Adam acaban aprendiendo quién es el bueno y quién no.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, la banda de los Dalton se propuso convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Este sueño se convirtió en pesadilla.

programme.title: I Pirati Della Malesia
programme.desc: Tra esotiche terre d’Oriente, il leggendario Sandokan guida i suoi uomini contro il dominio coloniale, tra battaglie navali e avventure senza sosta. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi, con Steve Reeves.

programme.title: La Promesa del Pistolero
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su mujer y su hijo a manos de un delincuente fugado, el sheriff Matt Austin se dispone a capturarlo, pero descubre que ha sido contratado por un codicioso barón de la tierra que pretende arrebatarle las tierras a una viuda y su hijo.

programme.title: Sandokan Contro Il Leopardo Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: La spacconata
programme.desc: El buscador Sandy Shaw, su pequeño hijo Rick y su fiel perro lobo Whisky emprenden un peligroso viaje en busca de una mina de oro mientras el codicioso empresario Barney Taft intenta encontrarla primero.

programme.title: Sandokan Alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: En Tombstone, un nuevo sheriff jura limpiar la ciudad de forajidos como los hermanos O'Hara y cuenta con la ayuda de un extraño abogado que siempre lleva consigo dos grandes libros de derecho.

programme.title: Erik Il Vichingo
programme.desc: Tra terre nordiche e battaglie epiche, il guerriero Erik affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per onore e potere, tra duelli e conquiste. Diretto da Mario Caiano con Giuliano Gemma.

programme.title: La Balada de Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Un gángster supuestamente muerto quiere implicar a un hombre completamente inocente para que pague por sus crímenes y así poder dar esquinazo a sus vengadores y perseguidores.

programme.title: Ercole Contro I Tiranni Di Babilonia
programme.desc: Tra complotti e battaglie spettacolari, Ercole sfida i tiranni di Babilonia per salvare il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: El último rebelde
programme.desc: La aventura de dos soldados rebeldes tras el fin de la Guerra Civil.

programme.title: L'assedio Di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all’avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: Ases y Ochos
programme.desc: Los pacíficos colonos de una ciudad destinada a la grandeza del ferrocarril se arriesgan a establecerse en el inexplorado Oeste y, de repente, son asesinados a tiros sin piedad. Sin ley ni orden, la justicia recae sobre los hombros de un anciano ranchero y un pistolero consumado pero retirado.

programme.title: Genoveffa Di Brabante - La Lancia Della Vendetta
programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

programme.title: La Fiebre de la Pradera
programme.desc: El ex sheriff borracho Preston Biggs consigue un billete de salida de la cárcel y un puñado de dinero para escoltar a tres novias por correo rechazadas medio locas hasta el tren más cercano de vuelta al Este.

programme.title: I Coltelli Del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Tra intrighi e vendetta in un’ambientazione nordica, un uomo combatte contro tradimenti e usurpatori per ristabilire giustizia, tra duelli e colpi di scena. Diretto da Mario Bava e Leopoldo Savona.

programme.title: Los Dias de la Ira
programme.desc: Un desaliñado chico de la basura se convierte en el pupilo de un famoso pistolero, y el escenario para el enfrentamiento se prepara cuando el pistolero invade el pueblo del chico mediante la violencia y la corrupción.

programme.title: La Rivolta Dei Mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: Fuera de la Ley
programme.desc: Tom Carter envía a su hijo Billy a buscar la ayuda del sheriff cuando la granja está siendo atacada por los secuaces del vecino Jon Pryce. Billy regresa, encuentra a su padre asesinado y se dispone a encontrar a los asesinos que contrató Pryce, Black Jack y su banda.

programme.title: Tharus Figlio Di Attila
programme.desc: Tra invasioni, vendette e battaglie epiche, il figlio di Attila sfida nemici e tradimenti per difendere il suo popolo

programme.title: El Valor de un Corbade
programme.desc: La banda de los Blackie lleva a cabo el atraco perfecto a un banco. Pero, ¿quién se llevó el dinero?

programme.title: Maciste Gladiatore Di Sparta
programme.desc: Tra arene, rivolte e battaglie spettacolari, Maciste sfida il potere per liberare gli oppressi e cambiare il destino di Sparta

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: Durante el fragor de la batalla en plena Guerra Civil, nace un potro seductoramente inocente de la querida yegua del soldado Jim Rabb. Rechazando la orden de matarlo para que no se convierta en un estorbo, Rabb se queda con el potro como consuelo en estos tiempos desesperados, un símbolo de esperanza que lleva a los hombres del Primer Arma de Caballería a un viaje de autodescubrimiento y nueva hermandad.

programme.title: Il Terrore Dei Mari
programme.desc: Tra arrembaggi e inseguimenti nei mari tropicali, un audace pirata sfida flotte nemiche e tradimenti per conquistare libertà e tesori. Un’avventura ricca di azione e colpi di scena, firmata da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: West of the divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva de Gentry el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Le Banni
programme.desc: Les légendes occidentales Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday et Billy the Kid s'affrontent pour prévaloir sur la loi et pour gagner les attentions de la vive renarde de campagne, Rio McDonald.

programme.title: Et le vent apporta la violence
programme.desc: Un homme se venge de la famille responsable de sa condamnation injustifiée à dix ans de travaux forcés.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: À Tombstone, un nouveau shérif s'engage à débarrasser la ville des hors-la-loi tels que les frères O'Hara, avec l'aide d'un étrange avocat qui se promène toujours avec deux gros ouvrages de droit sous le bras.

programme.title: Son nom est Pote
programme.desc: Après que Pot et son frère Ray aient dévalisé une banque, Pot est arrêté mais parvient à s'échapper. Il rencontre un bandit nommé Steve et ils complotent pour cambrioler une autre banque locale. Avec l'aide d'un croque-mort qui creuse ses tombes à la dynamite, ils réussissent à vider le coffre-fort. Cependant, ce que Pot ne sait pas, c'est que Steve coopère avec Lobo, un bandit mexicain, qui capture Ray afin de s'approprier tout l'argent.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: A Soldier's Revenge
programme.desc: Hanté par les horreurs de la guerre, Frank Connor, soldat de la guerre de Sécession devenu chasseur de primes, passe son temps après la guerre à s'occuper de deux choses : le whisky et les fugitifs.

programme.title: Bravo Django
programme.desc: Django Reagan est censé retrouver le coupable d'un vol, après avoir réussi à remettre la main sur l'argent volé. Il part à sa recherche dans le Montana, où la guerre fait rage entre éleveurs et colons.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: In the tunnels of a leafcutter ant nest, we uncover a Central American coral snake sharing the burrow. Nigel meets a rattlesnake without a rattle, and a young Mexican cantil uses its white tail tip to attract prey close for a deadly strike.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Snakes are highly-adapted to survive in the scorching deserts of Arabia, and Nigel's skills are tested to find his top ten. Will the saw-scaled viper's venom and lightning reflexes be a match for the backwards strike of the puff adder?

programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.
